declarations.name: fderiv_greenLimit_ne_zero_escape
declarations.doc: [escape base, step 5] `∇G_c ≠ 0` on `escapeOpen`.** On a ball `B ⊆ escapeOpen` about `z`, `G_c` has a holomorphic completion `F` (`Re F = G_c`); on `B ∩ slitPlane` both `F` and `bottcherLog` have real part `G_c`, so `Re(F − bottcherLog) ≡ 0`, forcing `deriv F = logDeriv φ_c` there; identity theorem ⟹ `deriv F = logDeriv φ_c` on all `B`. If `∇G_c(z) = 0` then `deriv F z = 0` (CR), so `logDeriv φ_c z = 0` — contradicting `logDeriv_bottcherCoord_ne_zero_escape`. So the escape region is regular for `G_c`, the base case of the critical-point propagation. Axiom-clean.

declarations.name: fderiv_greenLimit_ne_zero_critical_value
declarations.doc: [L4k — the critical value is a regular point] `∇G_c(c) ≠ 0`.** The critical value `c = f_c(0)` is not a critical point of `G_c`. Its forward orbit `f_c^[n](c) = f_c^[n+1](0)` never hits `0` (`critical_orbit_ne_zero`) and escapes (`exists_orbit_gt`); were `∇G_c(c) = 0`, the off-`0` propagation `fderiv_greenLimit_eq_zero_iff_quadratic` would push the critical point all the way out to the escape region, contradicting `fderiv_greenLimit_ne_zero_escape`. Hence `∇G_c(c) ≠ 0`. Combined with the saddle model (`exists_holomorphic_completion_critical`, where `F''(0) = F'(c)`), this makes the critical point `0` a **non-degenerate** saddle: `{G_c = G_c(0)}` is a genuine figure-eight. Axiom-clean.

The reach of the Real root tower is at least every vacuum window hanging on a zero-free crease stretch; the first possible obstruction is the first crease zero, where the transported sign may flip.

The remaining geometric core is the numerical propagation inequality `r_n/‖v‖ ≤ ‖v-c₁‖` plus backward containment in `Ext`.

declarations.name: logDeriv_bottcherCoord_escape
declarations.doc: [escape base, step 1] `d log φ_c = z⁻¹ + S'(z)` on ALL of `escapeOpen`** (off the slit too), where `S(z) = ∑ₖ termₖ` is the analytic correction. From `φ_c = z·exp(S)` (`bottcherCoord_eq_mul_exp`), `logDeriv φ_c = logDeriv(id) + logDeriv(exp∘S) = z⁻¹ + S'`. Slit-free version of `logDeriv_bottcherCoord_eq`, needed to bound `d log φ_c` near `∞` (Cauchy estimate on `S'`) and conclude `d log φ_c ≠ 0` far out — the base case of the critical-point propagation `fderiv_greenLimit_eq_zero_iff_quadratic`. Axiom-clean.

declarations.name: charged_clock_forces_multiplicative

The Möbius and scaling representations are the differential Lüroth and PGL₂-cocharacter inputs; the commutation is `ρ_λ Φ = Φ ρ_λ`.
